title: Define the typed visual asset registry and validated semantic-key manifest
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. Define a typed asset registry and allowlisted manifest schema for incident Route/Gate keys, incident emblems, the twelve City Moments, avatar/logo references and achievement keys. Each record includes its source prompt or origin, approval status, SHA-256 digest, sizes, transparent/UI variants, accessible labels and license/provenance metadata. Reserve the exact semantic keys from the incident table; engine data must not contain image paths. Represent missing or unapproved production art explicitly rather than substituting emoji or generic letter/number icons. The initial registry may contain pending metadata and synthetic test fixtures, but supplied mockups must not be marked as approved production assets.
acceptance: The registry has unique typed slots for all 36 operational keys, six incident emblems and twelve track-event keys.
Paths cannot escape the asset root; duplicate keys, digest mismatches and unapproved production entries fail validation.
The registry separates expressive content art from neutral UI chrome and provides accessible labels when resolving assets.
Tests use synthetic files; downloaded or generated assets cannot become approved without recorded review.
